title: Ring: the QR code and the 5 digit code, and no HomeKit code
description: Ring Alarm and most Ring devices carry a Ring QR code and a 5 digit code, usually on the back, scanned in the Ring app; on alarm devices the digits are the Z Wave PIN. Ring publishes no HomeKit code, and no Matter support was found.
lede: Ring's label is for the Ring app. There is no HomeKit code to find and, as of this check, no Matter support was found to pair with.

rows.term: The Ring QR and the 5 digit code
rows.text: Ring: Ring Alarm devices, along with most other Ring devices, come labelled with a unique QR code and 5 digit code, usually on the back of the device. On the Z Wave alarm devices the 5 digits are the Z Wave PIN, the first group of the device's DSK.

rows.term: If the phone will not scan
rows.text: In the Ring app tap Set up a Ring Alarm Base Station or Z Wave Sensor and continue manually.
No Ring page describes a HomeKit code, and no primary source shows Ring supporting Matter. Alexa can act as a bridge for Ring Smart Lighting, which is not Matter.
